sections.section_title: Clinical Presentation and Complex Patient History
sections.description: This section establishes the clinical context by detailing the patient's demographics, extensive comorbidities, and the chronological progression of valvular disease leading to the index presentation. It highlights the accumulation of risk factors that define the 'prohibitive surgical risk' profile.
subtopics: Patient demographics and baseline comorbidities (CAD, COPD, Diabetes, GI bleeding)
Timeline of prior interventions: Initial Lotus TAVI (2014) and first TAV-in-TAV with Evolut (2022)
Complications history: Vascular injury post-2022 procedure and Prosthetic Valve Endocarditis (PVE) caused by Enterococcus faecalis
Resolution of infection: Antimicrobial regimen and confirmation of sterile status prior to reintervention
Index presentation symptoms: Dyspnea, angina equivalents, and hemodynamic decline (EF drop and gradient elevation)

sections.section_title: Pathophysiology of Serial Valve Failure and Diagnostic Imaging
sections.description: This section explains the mechanisms behind structural valve deterioration in a multi-layered prosthesis environment, specifically focusing on the interplay between infective endocarditis damage and mechanical degeneration. It details the advanced imaging protocols required to visualize complex anatomy.
subtopics: Mechanisms of failure: Leaflet fibrosis, mechanical restriction from PVE, and calcific degeneration
Hemodynamic assessment: Interpreting gradients and Effective Orifice Area (EOA) in triple-stented anatomy
Role of Multislice CT (MSCT): Assessing frame interaction, minimum lumen diameter, and coronary ostial height
Evaluating Coronary Obstruction Risk: Neo-skirt formation, valve-to-coronary distance, and sinus dimensions
Exclusion of active infection: Integration of TEE, blood cultures, and clinical markers

sections.section_title: Strategic Decision-Making: Surgical vs. Transcatheter Reintervention
sections.description: This section outlines the multidisciplinary Heart Team reasoning process. It contrasts the standard guideline recommendation for surgery in PVE against the realities of this specific patient's anatomical constraints and operative risk scores.
subtopics: Guideline analysis: ESC recommendations for Prosthetic Valve Endocarditis management
Risk stratification: EuroSCORE II interpretation and impact of comorbidities (COPD, prior GI bleed)
Anatomical barriers to surgery: Challenges of explanting three integrated valve frames and potential need for root replacement
Feasibility of TAV-in-TAV-in-TAV: Criteria for proceeding with a third transcatheter intervention
Shared decision-making: Balancing life expectancy, quality of life, and procedural risks

sections.section_title: Procedural Execution: Technical Nuances of Triple-Valve Implantation
sections.description: A step-by-step breakdown of the third TAVI procedure, emphasizing the specific technical modifications required to navigate three overlapping stent frames. Focus is placed on device selection, positioning strategies to maximize EOA, and preserving future coronary access.
subtopics: Device selection rationale: Choosing the Acurate neo2 for supra-annular flow and low profile
Access strategy and wire manipulation in a constrained lumen
Pre-dilation techniques under rapid ventricular pacing to expand prior frames
Implantation strategy: High-depth placement to prevent leaflet folding and optimize EOA
Commissural alignment: Techniques to align new leaflets with old frames for future coronary re-access
Post-dilation protocols to ensure full expansion without causing embolization
